name: ArtMap Grid
description:
Client-side guides for 32×32 ArtMap canvases. G toggles the gray pixel grid, F toggles the four center crosses, and N toggles pink section guides. Choose section size in Mod Menu settings. All guides work independently and never become part of the painting.

Author: ani_kaa (Vanilla Game)

Source code: https://github.com/Vanilla-Game/ArtMap-Grid
